scope: Physical AX3000T R131 memory supplement and separate fixed-payload plateau investigation
original_frozen_guard: Investigate R131/R124 RssAnon or VmData increase greater than 24 KiB for batch cases or 4 KiB for idle/large fallback. No automatic acceptance; correctness failure blocks adoption.

limits: One window per exact ELF; diagnostic only, not statistical memory superiority.
Samples after drain barriers; not peak allocator or kernel socket accounting.
Maps classify private writable virtual mappings; this does not prove allocator ownership.
plateau_investigation.conclusion: All three exact ELFs have unchanged RssAnon, VmData, and exact maps bytes at both 1s/5s snapshots after 1/1000/10000 fixed events. R131 remains +12 KiB RssAnon and +28 KiB VmData versus R124; original guard remains flagged.

limitations: RssAnon is resident anonymous memory; VmData is virtual data mapping, not physical memory consumption.
Settled snapshots after 1/5 seconds are not peaks, allocator accounting or kernel socket memory.
No PSS or total physical memory superiority conclusion.
Two mirrored runs per original fixture, one per subject in plateau; no statistical superiority or equivalence claim.
Idle snapshots lack archived live executable/cmdline/starttime and FD listing; the fixed workload enforced affinity and FD transitions at run time.
Batch length limit is 16 KiB; this is not a Vec allocation-capacity limit.
The original +24 KiB guard is not retroactively changed or marked passed by this report.
guard_interpretation: The 1/8 KiB fanout cases use the +24 KiB batch threshold; 32 KiB fanout uses the +4 KiB large-frame fallback threshold. Idle and one-handler large-event cases also use +4 KiB. A strictly larger observed increase triggers investigation.
